decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 

Location Plan dated 29-May-2026, Section A-A & E-E Sections Sections As Existing 0300-L01, NE (Rear) & SE Elevation Elevations As Existing 0201-L01, SW (Front) & NW Elevation Elevations As Existing 0200-L02, Third Floor-Roof Plan Plans As Existing 0112-L01, First Floor-Second Floor Plan Plans As Existing 0111-L01, Basement-Ground Floor Plan Plans As Existing 0110-L01.

Section A-A & E-E Sections Sections As Demolition 0330-L01, NE (Rear) & SE Elevation As Demolition 0231-L01, SW (Front) & NW Elevation Elevations As Demolition 0230-L02, Third Floor-Roof Plan Plans As Demolition 0132-L01, First Floor-Second Floor Plan Plans As Demolition 0131-L01, Basement-Ground Floor Plan Plans As Demolition 0130-L01.

DESIGN AND ACCESS STATEMENT FOR BUILDING ALTERATIONS Revision I dated 16.10.2026, Third Floor Terrace Guarding Balustrade Details 5900-L02, Section A-A & E-E Sections As Proposed 0350-L03, NE (Rear) & SE Elevation Elevations As Proposed 0251-L04, SW (Front) & NW Elevation Elevations As Proposed 0250-L04, Third Floor-Roof Plan Plans As Proposed 0152-L04, Basement-Ground Floor Plan Plans As Proposed 0150-L03, First Floor-Second Floor Plan Plans As Proposed 0151-L02, Proposed Area Schedule Area Schedules (GEA, GIA, NIA) 0601-L01.

DLSL Neighbouring Window Sketch Sketches 9500-L02, Noise Impact Assessment Report VA6285.260409.NIA1.1 dated 09 April 2026, Energy & Sustainability Statement Rev A dated April 2026, Daylight And Sunlight by GIA dated 15th April 2026, Natural Ventilation (CIBSE TM52) Overheating Assessment Rev B dated April 2026, Operational Management Plan dated October 2026.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - The use of the external terraces shall not commence until the privacy screening, as shown on the approved drawings, has been installed. The screening shall be permanently maintained and retained thereafter.    

Reason: In order to prevent unreasonable overlooking of neighbouring premises in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - The development shall not be carried out other than in strict accordance with the Operational Management Plan hereby approved.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies G1, CC1, D1, A1, A4 and TC2 and TC4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
�

Condition : 6 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development with specified noise mitigation hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with machinery operating at maximum capacity and thereafter be permanently retained.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from mechanical installations/ equipment in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 7 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 8 - No music shall be played on the roof terrace hereby permitted.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies G1, CC1, D1, A1, A4 and TC2 and TC4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Erection of infill extension at first and second floors, new amenity terraces, shopfront alterations to front and rear, facade alterations at upper floors, roof works, new plant and associated works.
